quest.title: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
quest.description: You receive an invitation from the Knights of Favonius...

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

talks.objective: Read the Invitation Letter and attend
Go to Mondstadt to attend the event

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that's weird. Jean said this is where the event is supposed to be. But, there's nothing here...

choices.text: Wait, is this...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah! Now that you mention it... This is where our journey officially began.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sure brings back memories. Kinda nostalgic, really!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even after all this time, this place hasn't changed one bit.

choices.text: Fleeting moments...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, look who's getting all sentimental and poetic, hehe!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we still need to find Jean and the others. Let's have a look around.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just like old times.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah!

choices.text: ...Precious ones, too.
It's been a while since we've been back here.

talks.objective: Follow Paimon and keep moving forward

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why did someone hang Jumpy Dumpty mines all over this tree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To look like Sunsettias, maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? But, they don't look alike. You can't even eat them... Ah, hold on. Could this be an event setup thing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not a lot of people come here, but a bomb's still a bomb. If someone gets hurt by accident, Klee's gonna get marched off to the confinement room again.

choices.text: Agreed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... But, let's take a picture with the Kamera before we take them down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: First the Fungus and now this... Something weird is going on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it turns out not to be event-related, it'll be good to have a record of what we found.

choices.text: You know what, Paimon? You've gotten sharper.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You couldn't just compliment Paimon's smarts like a regular person? Hmph, whatever. Paimon'll take it — better than being called "emergency food," at least...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, it never hurts to be careful. We've seen through lots of tricks, but we've also gotten the short end of the stick a bunch of times too...

choices.text: I'm not getting a bad feeling this time, though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon likes the optimism!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, let's get that picture taken, then get rid of these bombs.

choices.text: For all we know, this could turn out to be an unexpected blessing.
You could even say you've "ascended to a new level."
Let's help her clean this up.

talks.objective: Take a picture of the unusual "fruit tree"
Follow Paimon and keep moving forward

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a Statue of The Seven!

choices.text: There are a few of these statues scattered across the land...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Among the seven gods, this god controls the wind." Haha, you remember too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's weird, though... It seems like there's something different about it.

choices.text: I think so too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's take a closer look.

choices.text: But I can't tell what at this distance.
...To show The Seven's protection over the world.

talks.objective: Go to the "Statue of The Seven"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon's sure of it now. This can't be for an event!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No one in their right mind would replace that huge Statue of The Seven with a statue of Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It pretty cute, though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... and well-made too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... But, that's not the point! You're not weirded out by this?

choices.text: Nope, because I've got it figured out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're right! This must be Alice's doing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...She could put a hundred Klee statues all around Mondstadt, and Paimon still wouldn't be surprised.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That explains the other weird stuff we saw up till now, too.

choices.text: Yeah, even though she hasn't showed herself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She must've asked Jean to write that letter so we'd lower our guard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, wait! Maybe that was Alice just pretending to be Jean... Paimon wouldn't put it past her.

choices.text: Looks like the jokes on us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Paimon's not upset.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The surprises were nice, and this statue is pretty cool. Plus...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We got to take a little trip down memory lane, hehe. Makes Paimon feel all warm and fuzzy, remembering where it all began!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Same here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do we do now, though? There's nobody around...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If this is some sorta elaborate prank, guess we're in it until the people behind it jump out and say, "Gotcha!"

choices.text: Maybe what Alice wants...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What does that mean?

choices.text: The Fungus, the Bombsettia Tree, the Statue of The Klee-ven...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah. And there could be even more...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess all there's left to do is touch that statue and find out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe it'll give you the power of Pyro or something!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The world opens itself before those with noble hearts.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Sparks 'n' Splash!

choices.text: She seems to have prepared lots of surprises for us.
Is for us to just keep going.
All in good fun, though, right?
We must already be inside her event.
Something this over-the-top... It's got "her" written all over it.

talks.objective: Take a picture of the Statue of The Seven

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There he is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Back then, Dvalin was tainted by the Abyss, and Tone-Deaf Bard was about to heal his wounds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But your control over Anemo wasn't so great, so they noticed you and ran off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you've had tons of practice since then, so mistakes like that should be a thing of the past, right?

choices.text: Or... we could just go say hi?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, no need to go for a full on reenactment. Let's go.

response.speaker: Dvalin
response.text: Ah, our old friends have arrived.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And it is our great pleasure to greet them.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Welcome to Mondstadt, you two — the place where it all began.

response.speaker: Dvalin
response.text: Apologies. You were just... even livelier than I remembered, and I wasn't expecting it.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Which means, mission accomplished on the surprise front, I suppose. Whaddaya say, Alice? High marks?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Oh, yes indeed. That was fantastic. I've recorded it all, in fact!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, so you were watching us all along! And, hold on... You can't just record people like that!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hehe, what a delightful reunion.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Welcome to Mondstadt, you two — the place where it all began.

choices.text: Let's give 'em a scare!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, sure! Here goes nothin'!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: RAWR!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... This is awkward. You really hung Paimon out to dry there, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I didn't think you were gonna take that approach...

talks.objective: Talk to Venti and the Hexenzirkel
Talk to Venti and the Hexenzirkel

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After some confusion, you and Paimon find yourselves at the Knights of Favonius headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Lovely to see you, dearies. So, what's the verdict? Did our special welcome ceremony meet the mark?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was very... "you," that's for sure. Paimon can't believe the Knights of Favonius let you go that far...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where'd you move the real Statue of The Seven, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh, gracious me. You still haven't figured it out...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: If I had actually done something to that statue, I would've been locked up in the teensy room next door by now. Certainly not my idea of a pleasant afternoon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Ah! Now, you're asking the right questions, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: The answer lies over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nicole! You're here too?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's right. Our two lovely mages are here on vacation. In fact, everything you just experienced was their handiwork.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: But, I'll leave the explanations to Miss Nicole. I trust you're well-acquainted with her skill at explaining all manner of magic and phenomena.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, we experienced that first-hand in Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: This bubble is a new kind of magic Alice and I invented. Inside it is a small world created using a person's memories.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: When you were busy reading that invitation to Mondstadt, Alice took the opportunity to place you within it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, we didn't even notice.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hah, I wouldn't be much of a Dodo-King if I couldn't pull off a simple trick like that...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: All that to say, the things you saw weren't real. They only exist within this bubble.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Ah, except for Venti and Dvalin, of course. I invited Venti, and he brought the dragon along.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's not every day you get to relive the beginning of your journey. It feels like... listening to a verse you haven't heard in a while, right?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You might not remember the name or melody, and still, you start humming along in no time...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm assuming your trip down memory lane was similarly nostalgic?

choices.text: Definitely.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, so does Jean know about this or not? Paimon's starting to think that invitation letter was a fake.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Oh, no no. Jean wrote that herself, I assure you. I wouldn't dare forge a letter under her name.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so you do draw the line somewhere...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Whew... Not with my daughter in her clutches... *sigh* If you ever become a mother, you'll understand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, c'mon. It's not like she's being held hostage!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: The point is... This magical bubble was created at the request of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: With the expedition in Nod-Krai coming to an end, the Knights will be home before long.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Varka thinks it's better to give people time to reunite with their families, so he told Jean to hold off on a huge welcome reception for now.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Of course, Jean has her own thoughts on the matter. You can get the details from her soon.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: As things stand, we're keeping the reception small, but there will be some activities.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: This magic bubble is one of them. The returning Knights can use it to catch up on all the major events that have occurred in Mondstadt while they were gone.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Simply put, it's a reenactment of your adventures!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Indeed. The ultimate goal is for everyone to have a chance to take part in the excitement.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what about the parts that took a few, um... creative liberties?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Oh, those were there because the bubble-world is still being transcribed and debugged.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Memories are easy to extract, and the resulting information density is fine, but it's not exactly a stable medium.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: If memories are the only thing used to recreate a world, it's hard to ensure a lack of deviations.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: For example, these memories belong to Venti. But, even for someone like him, whose memories are quite reliable, there's bound to be some variance.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Not to mention, on their own, memories lack an interactive component. So I added some self-deductive capabilities to this magic, which exacerbated the instability issues, unfortunately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, yeah. That, uh... makes sense.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: For instance... Say we're recording memories, and Lisa happens to fly into a fury over some overdue library books at the same time...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: A powerful thunderstorm might unfold in the bubble world out of nowhere.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Luckily, there's a simple solution. We just have to send someone to scout things out first. Then, we can manually correct anything that doesn't make sense.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Exactly. Plus, once the recording is complete, the magic will loop, so there won't be further deviations, and we won't need real people to act things out.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Ah, and before it's all said and done, we'll be sure to cover up your identity, Venti.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Much appreciated! Otherwise buying a round at the Angel's Share's gonna be much more of a hassle, hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like you're the one who does the buying...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: It's settled, then. We'll allow you to be the first to relive these precious memories, and in return, you'll be our eyes on the inside.

choices.text: I knew it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but it sounds like fun! Besides, we already snapped a few pics of some potential bugs... Like that weird Statue of The Seven.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Oh, no no, Paimon. That one was entirely intentional.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Seriously?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: As the creator of this world, I'm afforded a bit of creative license, I would think. Creating this bubble was no easy task. Is a little personal touch too much to ask for?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hehe, I doubt anyone will mind. As far as I'm concerned, you're free to do as you please. This is Mondstadt, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh well... Paimon can't argue with that.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: In that case, we'll be counting on you to continue testing our work tomorrow.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: It's still early. Why not check out the other events at the testing grounds in the meantime? Jean should be there, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we'll go say hi. She's the one who invited us, after all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks all. See you tomorrow.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Think nothing of it. Now that the world is at peace, you two are overdue for a vacation. Best to make the most of it.

choices.text: No such thing as a free lunch.
Thanks for going to so much trouble.

talks.objective: Go to the event venue to meet Jean

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, good work. We'll go with this set-up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jean! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Honorary Knight {NICKNAME}, Paimon, welcome back.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Did you have a good time in Alice's magic bubble?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it was so cool. Paimon's looking forward to getting back in there tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'll be sure not to spoil it, then. I imagine you might be interested in what went into the preparation, though.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I loved the idea when Alice brought it up, but I knew it would take a great deal of reenactors, not to mention recruiting Dvalin...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Luckily, Venti... Or, rather, Lord Barbatos agreed to help. After that, I opened up recruitment to the people of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Countless volunteers jumped at the chance to reenact your stories, Honorary Knight — it took me two days just to read through all the applications.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: A lot of people have gotten involved, and that includes quite a few familiar faces as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you one of them?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Haha, yes. According to Alice, I'm one of the "leading ladies."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope it wasn't too much work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. There are other activities here too, right? Sounds like there's a lot on your plate.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ah, well, such are the duties of the Acting Grand Master. I'm used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: For those of us who have been holding down the fort, so to speak, the return of the expedition team is a matter of great importance.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Grand Master contacted me and said not to organize a grand reception on their behalf, and I understand where he's coming from.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'm sure the team will be exhausted upon returning, and making a big fuss might just tire them out further...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sensing a "but" in there somewhere. Tone-Deaf Bard said you had other ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, well... Those of us here in Mondstadt have been awaiting their return for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Resuming normal life after such a long expedition will be quite an adjustment. An official welcome might help them feel at home and reacclimate to life here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Not to mention, it's a chance for the people to show them, no matter how long we've been apart, we're still family.

choices.text: That's also a good point.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, absolutely. And, I don't know... Perhaps I am overstepping. I just hope the Grand Master isn't too upset.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, besides the whole bubble thing... What've you got planned?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Here, I'll show you.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: First, this is an arena we've set up to showcase Favonius Bladework.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The Cavalry Company is in charge of this one. I'm sure there will be some exciting sparring sessions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that means we'll get to see Kaeya on stage!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: That's right. Compared to me, he's much better at keeping things interesting, even when the subject matter is quite serious. I can think of no better person for the job.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're as modest as ever, huh, Jean...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Over here, we're running a wind glider speed shooting event — it's not hard to guess who's in charge of this one, I'm sure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Amber, of course.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes. Her gliding skills are top notch, and she's quite creative when it comes to event design. Be sure to check it out when the time comes.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: There's also a booth that will serve as a reception area, where people can relax and chat with each other. A few simple games will be available as well.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Hertha is in charge of the drink stall, but we're still working on the menu...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: The more alcohol options the better, I think. The expedition team likes the strong stuff, haha.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Hm, fair poi— Huh!?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hahaha! What's with that face?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: G—Grand Master? Y—You're back? Has the entire team returned as well?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Apologies, we're not quite done with the preparations. But, I assure you, it's limited to what you see here. We're exercising the utmost restraint...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hey, hey. Relax, Jean, relax. No need to get all formal with me. I split from the group to make it back first. Pretend I'm not even here.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Besides, I knew you'd want to surprise us... no matter what I said, haha.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Oh... I see...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: If I didn't tell you to put on the brakes, I knew you'd go full throttle and start planning the next Ludi Harpastum or Windblume Festival...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: You put so much pressure on yourself, diving head first into the deep end without thinking about how much is on your plate... I just didn't want you to overwork yourself, that's all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wow... That's actually really nice of you.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Heh, well, looking out for my fellow knights comes with the job.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: As for the event... Food, drink, and fun in spades, without too much pomp and circumstance. Yep, it's just like a Mondstadt festival should be. The team will feel at home in no time.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: That's far too kind, Grand Master. But... Thank you.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Heh, I mean it, y'know. Just trust my judgment. Anyway, you two got a sec?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Now that I'm finally back in my old stomping grounds, lemme treat you to a meal. I'll even introduce you to the Good Hunter's secret menu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, nice! Paimon's never heard of that before!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hmm? What's wrong? Not hungry?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Actually, Grand Master... There's a few things I'd love for you to look over. Since you seem to have some time to spare...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Perhaps we could go back to headquarters first.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Uh, hang on, you know this is just a... pit stop, right? There's not gonna be time for me to take over the whole shebang...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Of course. Still... You are the Grand Master.

choices.text: Can't argue with that.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ah, you have no idea what this means... I'll be trapped in the office until tomorrow morning.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It's not that dramatic. If we make haste, we'll finish before dawn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As much as Paimon wants to check out that secret menu, you should at least do some work now that you're back.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Alright, alright. *sigh* Let's go...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Guess I'll... see you tomorrow...

choices.text: Can't help you there.
As long as we keep it small, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, and didn't you say Kleiner would be making the trip with you this time, Alice?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: He's been delayed, I'm afraid. Troublesome happenings on another planet... And, of course, just when he jumped through all those hoops to make it back to Teyvat, Dottore starts causing trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: The "border" is a terrible mess even now. So, unfortunately, his vacation has been postponed.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Just yesterday, he did give us a call on the Dodocommunication Device, though. As you can imagine, Klee was pleased as punch to hear her dad's voice.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I see. Being a "Seeker" is a tough job indeed...

choices.text: Worship Statue

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: Um, Klee can't reach those from here. And Master Jean says it's not polite to just take people's things...

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: So... Pass them to me when no one's looking, okay?

choices.text: Resonate with an Element

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: Resonate? Uh, what does that mean...? Oh, wait! I know, I know!

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: It's like how I'm the Spark Knight, and you're the Honorary Knight! So... we resonate!

choices.text: Statue's Blessing

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: Klee blesses you with... happiness!

response.speaker: Statue of The Seven
response.text: Have the best day ever, just like I am!

choices.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Dvalin appeared a little late, but it shouldn't be too big an issue. A trim here, a stitch there, and he'll be back in front where he should be.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Klee's Sparks 'n' Splash triggered a deep magical reverberation, causing the image to grow unstable. I'll need to check that out...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: And the background music needs to start half a second later when we're gazing out at Starfell Lake.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, I should put in another instance of trigger magic to control the pace.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: It was working fine before. We added two squirrels, and now the diagnostics are failing? I just don't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Nicole, dear, stop fretting. You're projecting rather loudly, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Every detail is within your control, huh... Color me impressed!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Dvalin appeared a little late, but it shouldn't be too big an issue.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: A trim here, a stitch there,

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: and he'll be back in front where he should be.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Klee's Sparks 'n' Splash triggered a deep magical reverberation,

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: causing the image to grow unstable.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I'll need to check that out...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: And the background music needs to start half a second later

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: when we're gazing out at Starfell Lake.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: ...Hmm,

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I should put in another instance of trigger magic

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: to control the pace.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: It was working fine before.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: We added two squirrels, and now the diagnostics are failing? I just don't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers there used to be Hydro Slime hiding here. But, it's gotta be gone now, righ—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, what was it Paimon said back then... Ah, right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wowwwww!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's Dvalin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "There's something huge... in the sky!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay. We all remember what Paimon said back then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, since he's here, that must mean...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're about to meet another old friend in these woods.
